notes.title: Help a not-so-average clown find their lost dog in Ayo the Clown
notes.notes:
Ayo the Clown is a new release from developer Cloud M1 where you assume the role of a not-so-average clown who sets off on an adventure to find their lost dog.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/help-a-not-so-average-clown-find-their-lost-dog-in-ayo-the-clown

notes.title: Enjoying Ayo the Clown?
notes.notes:
Hello,

Ayo the Clown is out for 2 days now, I hope you are enjoying our little game. After pouring our heart and soul into this game for more than 7 years, our dream is finally realized. The journey has been fun and we are very grateful for your support throughout the years.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35403232/4630653d296c17e4fc5e4137d13d203b3d24a8b4.jpg[/img]

Now that you had the time to play the game, we are very eager to hear about what you think of our game. Please leave us a [b]review [/b]because it's really important to us and the game, as we can improve the game based on your review and feedback, and also increase our exposure. 

Ayo Team.

notes.title: Go on an epic quest as a not-so-average clown trying to find their dog in Ayo the Clown
notes.notes:
Ayo the Clown is an upcoming adventure platformer from developer Cloud M1, it should be releasing this year and it looks so full of charm it could pop like a balloon at any moment.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/09/go-on-an-epic-quest-as-a-not-so-average-clown-trying-to-find-their-dog-in-ayo-the-clown

notes.title: Finally Ayo is On Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Ayo the Clown is launched on Kickstarter. Hurry and head over to grab the early birds and save some money while they still last. 

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1902165813/ayo-the-clown-a-playful-25d-platform-game

Thank you for your support throughout the years, we wouldn't have made it without you!

notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign coming August 1st.
notes.notes:
If you like what you are seeing, please mark your calendars. [b]August 1st[/b] is just around the corner. To ensure our [b]Kickstarter [/b]campaign's success (and our little clown's livelihood), it's crucial for you to back us on day 1. 
Don't forget to add us to your [b]WISHLIST![/b] Follow us on [b]Social Media.[/b]
Bring out your circusgoer spirit and help [b]spread the word[/b], maybe there's a sad kid who's a friend of your cousin's sister's brother's uncle's son who's in need of a game that can bring a smile to his face.
